description: The shared core of the Eclipse voice & telephony family: the Consent Registry and Number Registry every Eclipse telephony adapter obeys. Consent records are provenance-bound — a record without provenance is void, is refused at write time, and is receipted as a violation; revocation is one-way, total, and effective at the next check on every adapter because adapters hold no consent copies. DNC overlays and calling windows are versioned datasets with provenance; window checks run in the subject's timezone and an unknown timezone denies marketing contact. The Number Registry holds enrolled numbers only, each with A2P 10DLC / toll-free verification / STIR-SHAKEN / branded-ID registration state that decides sendability per channel and scope. The send gate evaluates consent first, then an Agent Wallet-shaped mandate (cap, platform + destination allowlists, approval threshold, expiry); a receipt carrying a consent_record_id is writable only when consent allows — an unconsented attempt produces a violation record and nothing else. V0 is fixtures only: no carrier account, no real numbers, nothing sent.
